calls.video_title: Uranium Hit a 20-Year High. The Stocks That Mine It Crashed 60% (Here's the Real 2027 Plan)
calls.thesis: Uranium Energy is the mirror image of Cameco — almost fully unhedged, so it realized ~$93/lb vs Cameco's ~$66; 'there's a tremendous opportunity' if it can show utilities signing more contracts at these higher prices.
calls.base_case: Recently signed two US utility deals for 1.1M lbs (2027-2032) priced at prevailing spot, no floor/ceiling.
calls.bull_case: Unhedged exposure to record uranium prices; analysts show ~161% upside; down ~50% in 3 months, so a contract-flow rebound could be sharp.
calls.bear_case: Not profitable yet; needs more utility contracts to drive revenue; being unhedged cuts both ways if spot falls.
